messages:
elaine: kicking off tenant_id_type migration during tonight's change window (01:00-03:00 UTC). plan: 1) apply schema toggle, 2) run streaming backfill, 3) flip contract. keeping canary small. details below.

sam: what's the canary size? and any lock-heavy steps?

elaine: canary = 5% traffic, targeted to low-traffic tenants. heavy locks only during final PK swap, trying to make that lock-free via CTAS swap. backfill will use chunked workers at 50r/s. :thumbsup:

mike: add explicit throttle on backfill workers. last time we spiked replica lag.

elaine: yes, we'll set backfill ratecap at 40-60 r/s and circuit at 700MB replication lag. if lag > threshold -> abort.

deploy-bot: Deploy created: migration/tenant-id-2026-03-20 by elaine. Canaries: route 5% to v2. Pin: service-api@2026.03.20-rc3

ana: elaine can you paste the exact DB commands we will run? want to save to runbook.

elaine: sure — snippet:

```sql
-- create shadow table
CREATE TABLE tenant_v2 AS SELECT * FROM tenant_v1 WITH NO DATA;
-- copy schema, indexes
ALTER TABLE tenant_v2 ADD COLUMN tenant_uuid UUID;
-- chunked copy job (pseudo):
INSERT INTO tenant_v2 (cols) SELECT cols FROM tenant_v1 WHERE id BETWEEN $start AND $end;
```

elaine: important: we won't run a global `LOCK TABLE tenant_v1` — use per-chunk transactions. final swap uses atomic rename and constraint toggle.

sam: rollback plan?

elaine: rollback = stop backfill workers, route canary back to v1, unpin and reapply feature flag off. if final swap already happened, we have a compensating migration that moves rows back for affected tenants (slow, manual).

mike: need a preflight check: validate unique constraints on tenant_v2 for a sample of rows. if duplicates -> abort.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks scheduled at 00:45 UTC: schema-compat, sample-constraint-check, replica-lag-monitor.

ana: can we add a temporary kill switch endpoint in service-api to stop consumers from writing to tenant_v2 during swap? if we need emergency freeze.

elaine: good idea — adding /admin/migrations/freeze-tenant-write. will patch service-api pinned version. deploy-bot already pinned api.

sam: oncall: @mike you own watch during swap (00:50-02:10). escalate to infra if replica lag > 700MB.

mike: got it. will monitor and post periodic snapshots to the thread every 10m.

elaine: release notes blurb for PMs: "Tenant ID migration: adds UUID tenant id, rollouts per-tenant. No downtime expected; canary first."

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 01:05 UTC. 5% traffic to v2. Monitoring dashboards linked: https://grafana/redwood/d/tenant-migration

ana: seeing small spike in p99 gen latency (~50ms) on canary, expected. :eyes:

mike: replica lag stable 120MB. continuing.

elaine: if we reach replica lag >700MB or error rate >2% on canary, we cut and rollback. everyone ack this plan?

sam: ack

mike: ack

ana: ack

elaine: 👍 starting timers. I'll post final swap plan at 01:50 UTC in this thread.
